name: Animated
description: Animation is a method in which pictures are manipulated to appear as moving images. In traditional animation, images are drawn or painted by hand on transparent celluloid sheets to be photographed and exhibited on film.

name: Comedy
description: Comedy is a genre of film in which the main emphasis is on humor. These films are designed to make the audience laugh through amusement and often exaggerate characteristics for humorous effect.

name: Thriller
description: Thriller films involve excitement and suspense, creating tension through menacing situations or seemingly inevitable outcomes.

name: Action
description: Fast-paced, high-energy movies with stunts and explosions.

name: Drama
description: Serious, character-driven narratives that explore emotional themes.

name: Horror
description: Intended to scare or startle viewers with suspense and shock.

name: Science Fiction
description: Futuristic and imaginative stories often involving advanced technology or space.

name: Romance
description: Focus on love stories and relationships.

name: Fantasy
description: Stories set in imaginary worlds with magic, mythical creatures, or supernatural elements.

name: Experimental
description: Films that challenge traditional storytelling and cinematic conventions, often abstract, non-linear, or highly artistic in nature.
